title: profilekit output manifest
description: Authoritative index of every generated artifact. Markdown and YAML artifacts cannot carry a schemaVersion of their own, so this file is the contract reference for all of them. Carries no timestamp: it is a committed artifact, so it must be byte-identical across runs over identical data.

schemaVersion.description: Output-contract version. Bumped only by a breaking change: a removed field, a retyped field, or a newly required field.
